data.name: Anwita
data.gender_notes: Anwita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anwita is derived from the Sanskrit word anu-wita, meaning 'graceful' or 'beautiful'. This name is associated with the goddess Durga and is believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and happiness. The name Anwita carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anwita usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of divine grace and beauty.
data.etymology: Anwita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anwita total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
